name: omnichannel-ads-expert
description: Omnichannel advertising expert covering account setup, creative production, campaign monitoring and optimization across major domestic and overseas media platforms.

displayDescription.en: End-to-end paid media specialist across Ocean Engine, Tencent Ads, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu, Google, Meta and TikTok — covering account setup, creative production, campaign monitoring and performance optimization.
displayDescription.zh: 覆盖巨量、腾讯、快手、小红书、Google、Meta等国内外媒体投放，擅长账户搭建、素材创意与优化。
